description: Additional version-shape classification coverage for both getter styles. A core getter accepts a bare version and rejects slashed, multi-slash, lone-slash and empty inputs; a regular getter accepts exactly one slash and rejects bare versions, multi-slash, lone-slash and empty inputs.

cases.expected_output:
group='v1' processable=true
group='v1beta1' processable=true
group='apps/v1' processable=false
group='a/b/c' processable=false
group='/' processable=false
group='' processable=false

group='batch/v1' processable=true
group='v1' processable=false
group='batch/v1beta1' processable=true
group='a/b/c' processable=false
group='/' processable=false
group='' processable=false
